title: Core click semantics: Terraria right-click (take one, equip swap, open crates and bags), Ctrl trash, Alt favourite, Shift quick-move, throw cursor, hold-repeat
player_outcome:
Right-click works like Terraria:
- It takes one item at a time and speeds up while held.
- It equips armor and accessories, swapping them out.
- It swaps worn armor with its vanity counterpart.
- It opens crates, bags and presents in place.

Ctrl+click trashes, Alt+click favourites, Shift+click quick-moves, and clicking the world throws the held stack.
design:
New src/Strata.Core/Gameplay/Items/SlotRef.cs:
- `enum SlotArea { Backpack, Coins, Ammo, Trash, Armor, Accessories, VanityArmor, VanityAccessories, Dyes, Misc, MiscDyes, Service, Container, Shop }`.
- `readonly record struct SlotRef(SlotArea Area, int Index)`.
- `[Flags] enum ClickMods { None=0, Shift=1, Ctrl=2, Alt=4 }`.
- `enum ClickOutcome { None, Moved, Equipped, Opened, Trashed, Favorited, Sold, Thrown }`.
- `SlotFilters.For(SlotRef, PlayerInventory)` returns the accept predicate per area and index (armor kind per index, accessory without duplicates, coins only, ammo only, dyes, misc kind).

Rewrite SlotActions.RightClick to Terraria rules, returning a ClickOutcome:
- An equippable item outside the equipment areas calls EquipFrom (swap).
- An item in Armor or Accessories swaps with the same index in VanityArmor or VanityAccessories.
- Otherwise take ONE onto the cursor, when the cursor is empty or CanStackWith with space left.
- The Minecraft half-split and place-one behaviour is removed.
- LeftClick is unchanged.

New partial src/Strata.Core/Session/GameWorld.InventoryActions.cs. `ClickOutcome ClickSlot(PlayerEntity p, SlotRef slot, bool right, ClickMods mods, SlotContext ctx)`, where `SlotContext(Inventory? Container, Town.TownNpc? Shop)`, routes clicks:
- Alt toggles favourite (Backpack, Coins, Ammo only).
- Ctrl (with no shop open) moves the stack to Trash[0], replacing the old trash item; favourites are refused.
- Shift quick-moves: container ↔ backpack; equip from backpack; unequip to backpack; sell when a shop is open (the Sell hook lands in P2-27).
- Right-click on an item whose ItemUseInfo.Consume.Loot != null calls ItemUseSystem.OpenFromSlot.
- Otherwise SlotActions.

Also add `ThrowCursor(PlayerEntity p, bool one)` and `ThrowStack(PlayerEntity p, ItemStack s)`: Drops.Spawn at Eye + Aim·0.6 with velocity (aim.x, 0.4, aim.z)·5 and pickupDelay 90. InteractionController.DropHeld (InteractionController.cs:193-202) reuses ThrowStack.

New partial src/Strata.Core/Gameplay/Interaction/ItemUseSystem.Slots.cs (ItemUseSystem.cs is at 375 lines): `public bool OpenFromSlot(PlayerEntity p, Inventory inv, int slot)` takes 1 from the slot and calls the existing private Open(p, table). Raises a new `Opened(PlayerEntity, ItemDef)` event, used later for a sound.
New src/Strata.Core/Gameplay/Items/HoldRepeat.cs: `IntervalTicks(int repeats) = max(1, round(30 * 0.75^repeats))`. Shared by right-click hold, hold-to-craft and hold-to-buy.

New src/Strata.Core/Commands/InventoryCommands.cs, registered in BuiltinCommands.CreateRegistry, so smoke scripts and CommandTests drive the same code:
- `invclick <area> <index> <left|right> [shift|ctrl|alt]`
- `invthrow [one]`
- `cursor` (prints the cursor stack)

tests:
SlotClickTests:
- RightClickTakesOneAtATime.
- RightClickEquipsArmorAndSwapsOld (iron_helmet over copper_helmet).
- RightClickEquippedArmorSwapsWithVanity.
- RightClickAccessoryWhenFullRotates.
- RightClickOpensWoodenCrate: crate count −1, loot and coins added.
- CtrlClickTrashesAndReplacesOldTrash.
- AltClickFavoritesAndTrashRefusesFavorites.
- ShiftClickMovesToOpenContainer.
- ThrowCursorSpawnsADrop (Drops count +1, cursor empty).
- HoldRepeatAccelerates: 30, 22, 17 … 1.
